observations: Photo 0 shows a Sony sound system with two large speakers and a central unit with blue LED lighting. The brand 'SONY' is visible on the top unit and on the speaker grilles.

Photo 1 shows the front control panel of the central unit with buttons, knobs, and a display showing 'AVOUR'S AS'. The unit has HDMI, USB, and other input ports. The brand is not visible on this panel.
Photo 2 shows the back of one speaker with 'SONY' embossed on the top panel. Wires are visible, and the speaker is placed in a room with other furniture and electronics.
The system appears to be a 2.1 setup with two satellite speakers and a central unit that may include a subwoofer or amplifier.
The lighting is blue and appears to be part of the system's design, not external lighting.
